stances_toward.note: The Shia duo: Hezbollah and Amal swept the May 2025 municipal elections together, walk out of the cabinet together over disarmament (7 Aug and 5 Sep 2025), and hold the Shia veto. Friction is visible and real: Speaker Berri is the state's interlocutor and proposed (4-5 June 2026) a simultaneous withdrawal of Hezbollah and Israel south of the Litani; opponents call Berri's network a 'deep state' that protects the party (Geagea, WINEP - a hostile voice); the two movements fought in the 1980s. Aligned by necessity with a rival's reservations: reluctant ally. Bond - kin: the same community.
